texts: So the biggest thing for me is the noise.
When there's a workshop going on in the main room, it's really loud.
And I'm trying to concentrate on editing or writing right next to it.
There's no quiet corner at all.
A quiet zone, or, you know, even just a partition, would help so much.
Second thing, a lot of the events are in German.
My German is, um, getting there, but it's not good enough for a technical workshop.
So more events in English, or at least bilingual, that'd be great.
Price-wise, I wouldn't say it's cheap, but I wouldn't say it's expensive either.
Um, yeah, that's what I have.
